notes.title: LIV Recording Tools, Rule Boards, Improvements
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings Archers![/h2][p][/p][previewyoutube="Ii68DvsB4l0;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Say Cheese! We have added awesome LIV recording tools to the game! With this tool you can easily record and take screenshots in the game. Use different record modes and adjust settings to catch the perfect shot to post online! We also improved rule explanations with tutorial boards along the Barkpaw Trials. 

[b]LIV Recording Tools[/b][/p][list][*][p]Implemented LIV recording tool. Spawn it from the in-game menu[/p][/*][*][p]Record and take screenshots within the game[/p][/*][*][p]Several modes varying from selfie to follow & 3rd person[/p][/*][*][p]Pin the tablet into the world to record amazing trick shots from a distance[/p][/*][*][p]Adjust quality, FOV, distance and other settings[/p][/*][*][p]Recording will affect performance[/p][/*][/list][p][b]
Gameplay[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added helpful rule boards along the Barkpaw Trails[/p][list][*][p]These boards are part of the tutorial when first time playing the game[/p][/*][*][p]They are positioned to explain certain rules[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Locked other maps and gameplay settings until Barkpaw Trails is completed.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved shortcut and ring obstacles
[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Improved bow audios[/p][/*][*][p]Improved haptics when shooting arrows[/p][/*][*][p]Improved out of bounds and course complete audios[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Small bug fixes
[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bow Course Demo[/b][/p][list][*][p]Limit the demo to first 6 targets of Barkpaw Trails[/p][/*][*][p]All other improvements from above, including LIV recording tools[/p][/*][/list][h2][/h2][p][b]Do you want to give feedback or ran into an issue? Join our discord![/b][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/AdtrzBhbFq"]https://discord.gg/AdtrzBhbFq[/url][/p][p][/p][p][b]Follow Korpi Games:[/b] [/p][p][url="https://linktr.ee/korpigames"]linktr.ee/korpigames[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Learn more about LIV: [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@poweredbyliv"]https://www.tiktok.com/@poweredbyliv[/url][/p]

notes.title: Bow Course - Archery Golf Coming To Steam July 15th!
notes.content:
[h2]Bow Course - Archery Golf is coming to Steam Early Access on July 15th![/h2][p][/p][previewyoutube="EQ5EdDhchvI;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Nock your arrow and challenge your friends in archery golf! [/p][p]Master realistic arrow physics and challenge your friends for a round in beautiful and challenging 9 target courses. Gain a competitive edge with skillful usage of different arrows, avoid obstacles and utilize shortcuts. The player with the least amount of shots in the end wins![/p][p][/p][h3]Main Features[/h3][list][*][p]Play solo or challenge up to 8 friends in multiplayer[/p][/*][*][p]Realistic bow handling & arrow physics[/p][/*][*][p]Versatile courses - Two 9-target courses offers several routes and shortcuts [/p][/*][*][p]Tactical use of different types of arrows[/p][/*][*][p]Fun and challenging gameplay — Easy to pick up but offers depth to master[/p][/*][*][p]Player customization - hats, vests, glasses, expressions, skin color[/p][/*][*][p]Unlockable map outfits - hat and vest for both maps (easy and hard difficulties)[/p][/*][*][p]Practice at the shooting range in the main hub area[/p][/*][*][p]Customizable difficulty - choose starting point, wind conditions & more[/p][/*][*][p]Play comfortably with teleport, smooth locomotion and other settings[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Wishlist now and get Bow Course on Steam July 15th!
